# TCL Android TV and Google TV
# Generated by debloat/research/build-lists.py on 2026-10-25 from debloat/research/tcl-hisense-xiaomi.md. Edit freely; rerunning overwrites.
#
#   bloat     hidden by ./debloat.sh by default
#   optional  hidden only with --include <group> (or --include all)
#   keep      left alone; debloat.sh refuses it
#   never     breaks the TV; debloat.sh refuses it (a trailing * matches every package starting with it)
#

never     other      com.tcl.autopair                                   Bluetooth remote service and pairing
never     other      com.tcl.common.shortcutmenu                        Remote key handling, fallback home, volume UI. Toolkit rates framework.custom "Critical"; 0x4f53 says "Important UI (volume controls)"
never     other      com.tcl.cyberui                                    The only HOME activity. Disabling it leaves the TV with no home and boot never finishes
never     other      com.tcl.factory.view                               Disabling them is reported to drop Wi-Fi (65C725 and others). Never launch factory.view either. 0x4f53 removes all three, and its comments report instability

never     other      com.tcl.inputmethod.international                  Default keyboard (TIME)
never     other      com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice                   Remote key handling, fallback home, volume UI. Toolkit rates framework.custom "Critical"; 0x4f53 says "Important UI (volume controls)"
never     other      com.tcl.partnercustomizer                          Carries the remote's TKey activity / keycode handling on those builds
never     other      com.tcl.providers.config                           Disabling them is reported to drop Wi-Fi (65C725 and others). Never launch factory.view either. 0x4f53 removes all three, and its comments report instability

never     other      com.tcl.showmode                                   Sound modes (Dolby/DTS/night), not just a demo
never     other      com.tcl.sourcemananger                             HDMI passthrough and the source/input menu (Android TV 9/11)
never     other      com.tcl.suspension                                 Quick Panel / Input key source panel. Disabled → Inputs button gone and no HDMI switching (Cobanov). CYT tcl-g05 says the Input key stops but HDMI still plays through a launcher

never     other      com.tcl.systemserver                               Remote-key plumbing

never     other      com.tcl.tv                                         Live TV app; plays HDMI; source picker on the Input key
never     other      com.tcl.tvinput                                    HDMI/AV/tuner input services. Disabling it gives "No Signal" (tcl-43p725). chrissy's table wrongly rates it "Safe"
never     other      com.tcl.tvpassthrough                              HDMI passthrough and the source/input menu (Android TV 9/11)
never     other      com.tcl.xian.StartandroidService                   Device authentication / boot hooks / Netflix ESN. Purpose unclear, so CYT keeps them on Realtek builds
